reply_lines: A perceptron is one tiny brain cell that says yes or no.
Stack many together and you get a real thinking helper — like me!
Every perceptron looks at what it sees and picks yes or no.
That simple choice, done millions of times, adds up to smart!
Training means showing the perceptron lots of examples.
Each example helps it learn a little bit more. Let us plan a training round!
Show it 100 cat pictures and 100 dog pictures.
After a while it can tell the difference all by itself!
Hi! I am Claude. Perceptrons are how I learned to talk!
Ask me about 'train' or 'brain' to find out how.
